766810404.text: Welcome to the Ia-I{RUBY#[S]No. 59}limmu Storage Array. This array is primarily used to regulate the operation of the Engraving and to store various research resources.

766810406.text: Oh, Paimon didn't really get what it was saying, but it sounds like we just need to follow the instructions on the screen to fix this thing, right?

766810407.text: And if this place is for "storing resources," that just means it's a "storehouse"! Paimon bets there are all kinds of super-amazing treasures nearby! Come on, let's give it a shot!
